test_rolling_mean: test the rolling mean function on a pandas Series with window size 50
test_rolling_sum: test the rolling sum function on a pandas Series with window size 50
test_rolling_std_var: test the rolling std and var functions with ddof 0 and ddof 1 on a pandas Series
test_rolling_center: test the rolling window with center=True on a pandas Series
test_rolling_min_periods: test the rolling functions with varying min_periods on a pandas Series
test_rolling_median: test the rolling median function on a pandas Series and DataFrame
test_rolling_cov_corr: test the rolling covariance and correlation functions on a pandas DataFrame
test_rolling_skew_kurt: test the rolling skewness and kurtosis functions on a pandas DataFrame
test_rolling_apply: test the rolling apply function with raw=True and raw=False on a pandas DataFrame
test_rolling_nans: test rolling functions handle NaN values correctly with min_periods on a pandas Series
